## lighting.applySkyPreset

Lights the scene with a sun and sky preset: Clear (the physical atmosphere, a 120,000 lux sun 40 degrees up: sunny, deep blue shadows), Hazy (thicker air, a paler sky and softer contrast), Overcast (an even gray sky of about 7,700 lux and a faint, very soft sun) or GoldenHour (the sun 6 degrees up, warm light and long shadows). Writes the sky light's source and settings and the directional light's rotation, intensity, color and shadow softness; keeps the light's azimuth unless sunAzimuth is given. A real sun clips to white under the active Post Process's manual exposure, so that turns automatic (Exposure compensation 0), and its AutoExposureMaxEV is raised to 16 when below 15. Creates 'Sky' or 'Sun' when the scene has none. One undo step; while playing it changes the running copy (warning). Returns {preset, changed, sky, light, createdSky, createdLight, sunDirection (toward the sun), sunIntensity (lux above the air), groundIlluminance (lux on a surface facing the sun at the ground), postProcess (the entity whose exposure was changed, or null), autoExposureTurnedOn (its manual exposure became automatic)}.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `scene` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorLightingCommands.cpp:1180`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `light` | string | no |   | The entity with the DirectionalLight to write; default: the brightest active one, or a new 'Sun' (entity ID). Pattern: `^[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,16}$`. |
| `preset` | string | yes |   | The preset. One of: `Clear`, `Hazy`, `Overcast`, `GoldenHour`. |
| `sky` | string | no |   | The entity with the SkyLight to write; default: the scene's first active sky light, or a new 'Sky' (entity ID). Pattern: `^[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,16}$`. |
| `sunAzimuth` | number | no |   | Degrees from +X toward +Z of the direction toward the sun (default: the light's own, or 20). Value: at least `-360.0`, at most `360.0`. |
| `sunElevation` | number | no |   | Degrees above the horizon (default: the preset's). Value: at least `-10.0`, at most `90.0`. |

## lighting.bakeProbes

Bakes reflection probes: renders what each one sees from where it stands now (the edited scene as it is: lights, sky, fog and the probes' current captures, its own included, so every further bake adds a bounce) into a new equirectangular HDR texture, Assets/Lighting/&lt;scene&gt;/&lt;probe id&gt;.hdr (' (n)' added when the name is taken), and sets the probe's Capture to it. The capture an earlier bake made for the probe goes to the trash once nothing else uses it (the open scene as it is in memory, even while its saved file still names it); any other texture Capture named stays. One undo step for the files and the captures. Answers once the textures are imported (a few frames; the editor keeps running). Needs a GPU; refused while playing (it renders and writes from the edited scene). Returns {directory, probes: \[{entity, name, capture, path, complete (false when something it sees was still loading after two minutes), previous (the capture before, or null), trashed}\]}.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `scene` · Answers later (MayDefer): yes · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorLightingCommands.cpp:1099`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `entities` | array of string | no |   | Probes to bake (entities with a ReflectionProbe component); default: every active probe of the scene (entity IDs). Items: at least 1. |

## lighting.extractSun

Makes the scene's directional light the sun of its sky's environment map: finds the map's sun in its source file (the brightest texel and the texels around it at least 4 times as bright as the sky there, at most 3 degrees across) and writes the light's rotation (pointing away from the sun as the sky shows it, the sky's Rotation applied), Color (the sun's color, its largest channel 1) and Intensity (the sun's illuminance in lux, times the sky's Intensity). The light is &#96;light&#96;, else the brightest active directional light, else a new entity 'Sun'. One undo step (none when the light already is that sun). Run asset.setImportSettings {&quot;RemoveSun&quot;: true} on the map afterwards so the sun does not light the scene twice (the Sky section's Extract Sun does both). Reads the file in the background and answers in a few frames; refused while playing. Returns {light, created, changed, map, direction (toward the sun), color, intensity, illuminance (the sun's luminance per unit of the sky's Intensity), angularDiameter (degrees), texels, clipped (the file clipped the sun: its light is a lower bound, and warning says so)}.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `scene` · Answers later (MayDefer): yes · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorLightingCommands.cpp:1204`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `light` | string | no |   | The entity with a DirectionalLight to write; default: the brightest active one, or a new 'Sun' (entity ID). Pattern: `^[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,16}$`. |
| `sky` | string | no |   | The entity with the SkyLight whose environment map holds the sun; default: the scene's first active sky light (entity ID). Pattern: `^[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,16}$`. |

## lighting.makeAreaLight

Makes an emissive panel a real light: adds a child Rect Light on the panel's emitting face with the panel's luminance and size (Units Nits), and tags the panel Light Surface so its emission is not counted twice (screen-space reflections, probe captures and the light's own shadows leave it out). Use it on any thin emissive mesh (ceiling panels, signs, screens); the panel keeps its look. &#96;side&#96; auto takes the thinnest axis of the mesh's bounds times the panel's world scale when it is under half of the next, and of its two faces the lower one when that axis is within 45 degrees of vertical (a ceiling panel); pass side for wall panels. Waits while the mesh or material loads; fails, changing nothing, on an entity without a mesh, a material that emits nothing, a face that already has a Rect Light child, or while playing. One undo step removes the light and the tag. Returns {light, panel, side, size (meters in the world), luminance (nits), color, lumens (pi x luminance x area, twice for two-sided), tagged (the tag was added)}.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `scene` · Answers later (MayDefer): yes · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorLightingCommands.cpp:1283`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `castShadows` | boolean | no |   | The light casts soft shadows (default true). |
| `entity` | string | yes |   | The emissive panel: an entity with a MeshRenderer (entity ID). Pattern: `^[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,16}$`. |
| `offset` | number | no |   | Meters in front of the face, along its outward normal (default 0.001): keeps the light off the panel's own surface. Value: at least `0.0`, at most `0.10000000149011612`. |
| `side` | string | no |   | Which face of the mesh's local axes emits; default auto. One of: `auto`, `+X`, `-X`, `+Y`, `-Y`, `+Z`, `-Z`. |
| `twoSided` | boolean | no |   | The light emits from both faces (default false). |
